SORA_SP.title: SP (Situation Points)
SORA_SP.description:
Current: [gold]%SP%[/gold] / %MAXSP% SP. 

At 30 [gold]SP[/gold], Situation Commands become available and SP gained from attacks, Links, and turn-start effects is doubled.

This multiplier does not affect SP gained from card effects. 

At 60 [gold]SP[/gold], add [gold]Ultimate Form[/gold] into your Hand.
